simple.meaning: חֲלִי (chălîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a trinket (as polished).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲלִי (H2481) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 25:12, with occurrences in Proverbs, Song of Solomon.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲלִי (H2481) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲלִי (H2481) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֲלִי (chălîy) / H2481 is traced through Proverbs 25:12, Song of Songs 7:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2481. chali I. חֲלִי noun masculine ornament , וַחֲלִיכָּֿ֑תֶם זָחָב נֶזֶם Prov 25:12 a (nose-or-ear-) ring of gold and (neck-or breast-) ornament of fine gold ; plural חֲלָאִים Cant 7:2, in simile of grace and beauty.
